chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on optimizing memory at test time by treating the memory module as a learnable component updated based on input tokens, aligning with the test-time training paradigm.
ATLAS reframes temporal evolution as an optimization process where the memory is updated to memorize context, which is a core characteristic of gradient-state recurrence.
The paper addresses long-context understanding and memory capacity limitations, which are central themes in Infini-attention and related compressive memory architectures.
